exact_statement: For every fixed singleton-leaf hierarchy T with internal arity 2 or 3 and L_T(S)=1+sum_v b_v*1{S meets C_v}, put Gamma_T(u)=sum uhat(S)^2 L_T(S), W_T(u)=Gamma_T(u)-1. For actual Boolean u,w, W_T(uw)=W_T(u)+W_T(w)-4sum_v b_v P(D_v(u)=D_v(w)=1), where D_v is disagreement under independent resampling of C_v with its outside held fixed. For three Boolean signs g,q1,q2, Gamma_T(g*q1*q2)=Gamma_T(g)+W_T(q1)+W_T(q2)-4sum_v b_v P(D_v(g)+D_v(q1)+D_v(q2)>=2). For disjoint nonempty coordinate blocks C,U,V,Y of sizes r,s,t,k, compatible events A={C=c*,U=u*}, B={C=c*,V=v*}, masks q1=1-2*1_A,q2=1-2*1_B and fixed binary tree T=(T_Y,(T_C,(T_U,T_V))), W_T(qj)<=6I(qj) and I(q1)+I(q2)<=2I(q1*q2), hence H(g*q1*q2)<=Gamma_T(g*q1*q2)<=Gamma_T(g)+12I(q1*q2) for every Boolean source g. If g=h(Y) has Gamma_(T_Y)(h)<=K I(h), then H(g*q1*q2)<=max(K+2,12)I(g*q1*q2). Source-dependent cancellation and a universal source-cost payment are not assumed.
hypotheses: Uniform actual Boolean signs; entropy and code lengths in bits; I is physical pivotal influence.
Tree and ordered child coordinate cells are fixed before sampling the Fourier set.
D_v uses independent uniform resampling inside C_v and identical outside coordinates.
Compatible-mask conclusion requires r,s,t,k>=1 and the common assignment c* to agree.
Edit operation is sequential flips/XOR, so the intersection is flipped twice.
Arbitrary-source conclusion retains Gamma_T(g); it is not replaced by an unproved K I(g).
Final-influence closure additionally requires an independent Y-only source with the specified paid core code.
